statement: Trivial involution entries not met by S_gen, with [phi] and [phi^-1] identified for F = K (Lemma 6.6(i)); each gives one lattice with Aut L = {+-1, +-sigma}.
scope: The list entries and their lattices. Completeness of the gluing lists and correctness of the identifiers are inputs (§4, Lemma 6.6).
